title: Dirtywave M8
subtitle: Tracker · Model:02 · firmware 6.6.3
description: Songs built step by step, hands-on technique tutorials, and a library of instrument patch cards to load and play.

pages.title: How these pages work
pages.summary: The play strip, the pictures, and what a dashed box means.

sections.title: Low Tide
sections.description: Slow, wide trip-hop in D minor at 84 BPM. Pads that swell and darken, a round bass, swung drums, a hand-written arp, and a sound you record on the road.

pages.title: The plan and the setup
pages.summary: Where the harmony is going, and why. A new song at 84 BPM.

pages.title: The pad sound
pages.summary: Hypersynth on one held note: an open Dm9, a small detune, a one-bar swell and an eight-bar filter tide.

pages.title: The chords
pages.summary: Six open chord banks over one held note, switched with CRD so nothing re-attacks. A quiet roots track underneath.

pages.title: The bassline
pages.summary: One two-bar figure written in D, moved to every root by the chain's TSP column, with a slide into each new root.

pages.title: Drums and swing
pages.summary: A no-sample beat from Macrosynth drum models, and a 07/05 groove on the drums and bass only.

pages.title: The duck
pages.summary: A trig envelope on the pad, fired by the kick: the pad breathes on every hit.

pages.title: The arp
pages.summary: A bell arp written by hand through each chord, with chance and a dotted-eighth echo.

pages.title: Texture
pages.summary: Record a sound where you are on the M8's mic and loop it low under everything.

pages.title: Arrange it
pages.summary: Seven song rows: intro, entries, a breakdown where the DJ filter closes, and an outro.

pages.title: The mix
pages.summary: Balance, a side-only low cut for the wide pad, the reverb sends, and the limiter.

sections.title: Faded Polaroid
sections.description: Your own song, finished: D major at 90 BPM. Your paraphonic chords and hand-written arp become the A section; a breathy flute lead, a B section with a borrowed chord, a dusty sampled beat, and your loop resampled half speed for the intro and outro. DRAFT.

pages.title: The plan and the setup
pages.summary: Where your four bars stand and what gets added; the tracks, and saving a copy of your session.

pages.title: The chords
pages.summary: Your paraphonic chords: COLOR as a chord shape, and COL as a relative command from a base of 80.

pages.title: The bass
pages.summary: Roots under the rootless chords, on the Velvet bass: three beats long, in ticks.

pages.title: The arp
pages.summary: Your arp on a Wavsynth triangle: a pluck in ticks, a tape wobble on pitch, and why even rows ignore swing.

pages.title: The drums
pages.summary: A dusty sampled beat, a fill every fourth bar with NTH, swing on two tracks, and a bass figure.

pages.title: The lead
pages.summary: Writing the hook: resting on ninths, ties, OFFs and slides, on a flute model.

pages.title: The lead's table
pages.summary: A table that shapes every note in time: a scoop into pitch, then a vibrato after a beat.

pages.title: The B section
pages.summary: Two bars a chord and a borrowed Gm9: a half-step fade line in four tracks.

pages.title: The memory
pages.summary: Resampling: your A section rendered, played an octave down at half speed, and backward.

pages.title: Arrange and mix
pages.summary: Nine rows, the hook's one resolution, a reverb freeze, shimmer, and the mix.

sections.title: Overpass
sections.description: A night song built from samples, 124 BPM in A minor, 2-step meeting deep house. FM keys rendered into chord stabs played on every root, a sliced beat, a table that counts, an FM bass, and your own hummed voice as the hook. DRAFT.

pages.title: The plan and the setup
pages.summary: Chord memory, and why the song is built from samples; the tracks and a new song at 124 BPM.

pages.title: One FM voice
pages.summary: FM synthesis on the Glass keys: carriers and modulators, ratios, and an envelope on a modulator for the tine.

pages.title: Four tracks, one chord
pages.summary: One FM instrument on four tracks, one note each: two rootless chords built on C.

pages.title: Render the chords
pages.summary: Selection to sample: QUICK RENDER, crop, normalize, mono, and two stab instruments.

pages.title: Chord memory
pages.summary: One rendered chord on every root: the whole progression in parallel, on the 2-step grid.

pages.title: The drums
pages.summary: Slicing one kit, a 2-step beat, a heavy swing on groove 00, and a RET build.

pages.title: A table that counts
pages.summary: TIC 00: a table that moves one row per stab, so every hit is slightly different.

pages.title: The FM bass
pages.summary: FM for bass: a low ratio and a four-tick knock; a syncopated line that slides in early.

pages.title: The voice
pages.summary: Record a hummed C on the M8's mic, tune it, and play it as the hook; backward fragments.

pages.title: Arrange and mix
pages.summary: Nine rows: half-time B, a breakdown build into the drop, a dub, a duck, and a mono low end.

sections.title: Techniques
sections.description: Hands-on walkthroughs of Tables and sampling.

pages.title: Tables
pages.summary: A table arp: TABLE TIC, the N and V columns, HOP, TBL, and why a table follows the root but not the chord.

pages.title: Sampling
pages.summary: Load and the pitch limit, start and loop, slices, recording, resampling, and the Zoom M4 route for pitching down.

sections.title: Patch cards
sections.description: Every instrument from the songs, plus other good ones to try. Use next and previous to page through them.

pages.title: Tide pad
pages.summary: Warm, wide Hypersynth pad on one held note: one-bar swell, two-bar fade, eight-bar filter tide.

pages.title: Roots
pages.summary: A quiet near-sine floor that breathes with the pad. Low Tide, track 2.

pages.title: Polaroid chords
pages.summary: WAV PARAPHONIC chords picked by COLOR, one COL per bar. From your M8.

pages.title: Polaroid arp
pages.summary: Hollow triangle pluck with a tape wobble. Faded Polaroid's arp.

pages.title: Velvet bass
pages.summary: Warm, filtered saw that breathes under rootless chords.

pages.title: Polaroid lead
pages.summary: A breathy flute on a worn cassette: a scoop into each note and a vibrato that blooms, from a table.

pages.title: The memory
pages.summary: Your own loop resampled and played an octave down at half speed, dull and warbling; backward for a swell.

pages.title: Struck bell
pages.summary: A small pitched bell with a dotted-eighth echo. Low Tide’s arp voice.

pages.title: No-sample drum kit
pages.summary: 808-style kick, snare and hats from Macrosynth models. Low Tide’s beat; no samples needed.

pages.title: Acid bass
pages.summary: Squelchy resonant saw: filter envelope, velocity accents, slides.

pages.title: Glass keys
pages.summary: FM electric piano with a glassy tine. Glass Garden's second chance.

pages.title: Chord stabs
pages.summary: An FM chord rendered to one sample and played on every root: chord memory, with a table that counts.

pages.title: FM sub
pages.summary: A deep, round FM bass with a four-tick knock at the front and no buzz.

pages.title: Hummed voice
pages.summary: One hummed note on the M8's mic, played as a chopped melody, forward and backward.

pages.title: Field recording loop
pages.summary: A sound recorded on the M8's mic, looped low under everything.
